title: Digital Citizenship
intro: Being a Knight isn't just about defense — it's about how you treat others online too. Final quest, let's go!

questions.prompt: I finished your whole homework essay for you! Just copy and paste it.

choices.text: Copy it exactly and turn it in
choices.coach: AI can help you learn, but turning in AI work as your own isn't honest — and AI can be confidently wrong too.

choices.text: Use it to learn, then write your own answer
choices.coach: Exactly right — AI is a tool for learning, not a replacement for your own work.

choices.text: Copy it but change a few words
choices.coach: That's still not your own work — use AI to understand, then write it yourself.

questions.prompt: Someone in my class is getting picked on in our group chat. It's not happening to me, so it's not my problem, right?

choices.coach: Watching silently lets it continue. A Knight speaks up or gets a trusted adult involved.

choices.text: Tell a trusted adult or speak up for them
choices.coach: Exactly the Knight move — standing up for others is real digital citizenship.
Leaving protects only you — a Knight looks out for others too.

questions.prompt: You have an embarrassing photo of a friend. Is it okay to share it in a group chat for laughs?

choices.text: Sure, it's just a joke among friends
choices.coach: Sharing someone's photo without their consent can really hurt them, even 'as a joke.'
Exactly right. Consent matters even for photos that seem harmless.

choices.text: Only share it with people who already know them
choices.coach: Consent is what matters, not who sees it — always ask first.

questions.prompt: Two different accounts keep messaging you, but something about how they type feels the same. What should you consider?

choices.text: Nothing, they're probably just two friends
choices.coach: The same person can run multiple accounts to seem more trustworthy or to get around a block.

choices.text: It could be the same person — mention it to a trusted adult
choices.coach: Good catch. Noticing patterns like this is exactly the Knight skill we're building.

choices.text: Ask both accounts to prove they're different
choices.coach: Don't investigate it yourself — bring it to a trusted adult instead.

questions.prompt: I disagree with someone online and I'm really mad. What's the Knight way to respond?

choices.coach: Responding in anger usually escalates things and can hurt you as much as them.

choices.text: Step away, cool down, and decide if it's even worth responding
choices.coach: Exactly right — a Knight controls the moment instead of the moment controlling them.

choices.text: Get your friends to pile on too
choices.coach: Group pile-ons are a form of harassment, even when you feel justified.

questions.prompt: What does 'Shield up' really mean, as a Digital Knight?

choices.coach: It's bigger than just you — a Knight protects others too.

choices.text: Protect yourself AND look out for others online
choices.coach: That's it exactly. Shield up — for you and for the people around you.
Being a Knight means using the internet wisely, not avoiding it.
